description: This file defines the MonkeyInstrumentationEvent class, which extends MonkeyEvent, used for injecting instrumentation events in Android's Monkey testing framework. It manages details related to starting instrumentation tests on specified components, including handling remote exceptions.

classes.name: MonkeyInstrumentationEvent
classes.description: Represents an instrumentation event that can be injected into the Android system during testing. It encapsulates the component name, test case, and logic to start instrumentation tests via the activity manager.

methods.name: MonkeyInstrumentationEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with the given test case name and runner name.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the instrumentation event into the system by calling startInstrumentation on the activity manager. Handles remote exceptions and validates the component name.
